capabilities: Write created_device on first appearance of a note
Write modified_device when a human types locally
Filter out synced-in and programmatic editor changes
Store device names per device in localStorage
Support Dataview queries over the device fields
disambiguation: Not a human/AI authorship tracker; it records which machine touched the note, not who or what wrote it.
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin directory (manual install instructions provided) and marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. iOS is not supported. Documentation is available in English and Chinese. Device names are not backfilled for pre-existing notes.
problem: File-sync tools keep vaults in step but lose the information of which machine created or last edited a note, and naive tracking breaks because synced-in files count as modify events.

relations.evidence: Once the fields are in your notes, Dataview can filter on them

summary: Provenance plugin that records which device created and last edited each note in frontmatter, ignoring changes that arrive through sync.
